· the first plan sign-in on a host · said once
╭─ You're using your ChatGPT plan ─────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ This session spends your ChatGPT plan's allowance, not API credit. A     │
│ Plus plan shares one five-hour allowance across every app that uses it,  │
│ ChatGPT included.                                                        │
│ Usage is shown and managed at https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage.        │
│ If the allowance runs out shhh stops and says so. It never moves to an   │
│ API key on its own.                                                      │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
